messages:
nina: FYI we started seeing mTLS resumption failures in ap-east this morning after the RBAC cleanse. Downstream services see 0RTT/Session ticket rejects and proxy logs show "keystore: unresolved principal" during ticket unwrap.

omar: saw the same. Error rate ~0.8% on ingress proxies for ap-east between 03:40-03:58 UTC. Users report higher latency as full handshakes kick in.

kevin: paste from proxy log:
```
2026-04-05T03:41:02Z ingress-3 INFO session ticket unwrap failed err=keystore: principal-not-found key=alias/session-ticket-ap-east req=bb72c4
kms: AccessDenied when calling KMS:Decrypt for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-session-handler
```

deploy-bot: rbac/keystore-session-cleanup rollout completed 2026-04-05T00:15Z in all regions.

oncall: paging security and infra. This is affecting a subset of customers with long-lived sessions.

nina: quick check: are session tickets encrypted with the same key as cert private keys? If so, keystore access required for ticket unwrap during resumption.

omar: yes. Session-ticket key is managed in KMS alias/session-ticket-ap-east and key-policy expects explicit role ARNs. The RBAC cleanup renamed several keystore roles to remove service-account-temporary principals. Looks like some new role ARNs were never added to the key policy.

 audIT-bot: audit-bot: CloudTrail shows kms:Decrypt denied for reqs in the window; however some denied entries have missing principal field due to truncated delivery. Raising a ticket with cloud infra for audit delivery loss.

kevin: immediate mitigation options:
- re-add old role ARNs to key policy (fast but reintroduces old principals)
- add a short-lived policy statement allowing keystore service account (sa-keystore) via aws:PrincipalTag check (requires infra approval)
- revert RBAC rename (needs approvals)

nina: perform fastest: patch key policy to include sa-keystore tag-based principal check if cloud supports it, otherwise re-add old role ARNs for 24h. I'll try tag-based patch in ap-east first.

omar: I'm prepping a canary: curl -H "x-req-id: canary-rt-1" https://keystore.ap-east.internal/decrypt -d '{"key":"alias/session-ticket-ap-east","cipher":"..."}'

kevin: policy patch applied in ap-east: added condition "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/role":"sa-keystore"} to allow kms:Decrypt. Waiting propagation (30s).

omar: canary result: req=canary-rt-1 status=200 decrypt_ms=48. Resumption errors dropped to baseline in ap-east.

oncall: scheduling backfill of ticket unwraps and session refreshes for affected tenants. Alert created: KEYSERVICE.UNWRAP_DENIED > 0.5% for 5m triggers pager.

nina: post-incident follow-ups:
- add a preflight check in RBAC rename job that diffs KMS key policies for aliases used by keystore and fails the job on mismatch
- add unit test to keypolicy updater to ensure tag-based principals are propagated across regions
- ensure CloudTrail delivery reliability; escalate missing principal fields with infra
- document session-ticket key access mapping in keystore runbook

kevin: creating PRs for policy updater and the playbook. Will keep old role ARNs in key policies for 48h as a safety buffer.

audit-bot: created audit ticket: AUD-2026-0991 (missing principal field on some KMS denies).

nina: postmortem owner: nina. SLA impact: increased handshake latency for ~18 minutes in ap-east; customers affected: session-heavy tenants. Closing thread after incident doc linked.
